pages.text: $(o)A living pillar of obsidian on the outer islands of the End.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It drops anvils, raises pillars and sends waves across the floor. Jump the waves and stay off the center when it rises.$(br2)It hits hardest of all the optional bosses. Bring the whole party.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Obsidian Heartstone$() counts for the quest book.
